thread:
Nadia R: hi @people-ops  putting this in a private thread. my partner just started chemo and i'll need to accompany them to appointments a few times per month. i'm asking for: intermittent caregiving leave (up to 3 days/month), flexible hours for the appointments, temporary reduction in customer-facing duties for 2 months, and an adjustment to my midcycle review (either brief extension or reweight deliverables). would prefer this to stay confidential in HR. any guidance on next steps?

Ethan - Manager: Nadia  i'm so sorry to hear this. fully support you taking what you need. engineering can cover customer calls and oncall while you attend appointments. we can make the review adjustment; i don't want this to impact calibration. i can limit my manager notes to "approved caregiving accommodation" and dates.

Harper - People Ops: Nadia  thanks for sharing and sending love. we do a short interactive process: 1) private call to document needs, 2) draft time-limited accommodation letter (dates, scope), 3) implement schedule changes and update review timeline in the HRIS. provider note is helpful but optional for caregiver leave; medical documentation for the partner can be attached if you want. everything will be stored confidentially. can we book a 20m call today?

Nadia R: thanks, i appreciate that. i don't have any paperwork right now. i mostly need the ability to take intermittent paid caregiving days and to move demos that fall on appointment days. also would like to avoid having this show up as a negative in the review.

Samira - HR: Nadia  employer-protected caregiving leave options differ by location, but we can offer an internal accommodation regardless. typical draft language:

```
Accommodation (draft):
- Caregiving leave: up to 3 paid caregiving days per month for 3 months (use as needed for partner appointments)
- Schedule: flexible start/end for appointment days; permission to shift demos when needed with 24h notice
- Duties: temporary reduction in customer-facing meetings; teammates to cover critical calls
- Review: extend midcycle review window by 6 weeks or reweight affected deliverables, per your preference
- Privacy: accommodation recorded in confidential HR file; limited manager note: "approved caregiving accommodation"
```

Harper - People Ops: if that wording works i'll file the formal note and coordinate with your manager and scheduling for oncall/demo coverage.

Luis: i'm happy to swap oncall and cover customer demos on days you have appointments. leave a calendar note and i'll take them.

Ethan - Manager: i'll update the team calendar and confirm which demos we can postpone. i'll also flag your review for reweighting in calibration so reviewers see only factual changes.

Nadia R: that draft looks good. i'd prefer the 6-week review extension rather than reweighting. i also want the accommodation to start immediately and be reviewed after 3 months.

Samira - HR: noted. next steps: 1) 20m private call to confirm start date and wording, 2) Samira will file the confidential accommodation letter with the 3-month review date, 3) Ethan + Luis will update oncall/demo rota. we'll mark the review extension in the HRIS.

Nadia R: thank you all. DM'ing to schedule the call now. really grateful for the support and discretion. :heart:
